mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-251159c1.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    # Each marker becomes a 5x5 framed structure centered on it; cardinal marker-to-marker
    # direction determines the colors used on the corresponding side of the frames.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    # source demo: two points along shared horizontal axis; nearest other point gives orientation
    for r, c in pts:
        # 5-wide top/bottom edge, 4-wide side bars, marker retained at center
        for dc in range(-2, 3):
            if 0 <= c+dc < w:
                if 0 <= r-2 < h: out[r-2][c+dc] = 5
                if 0 <= r+2 < h: out[r+2][c+dc] = 8
        for dr in range(-1, 2):
            if 0 <= r+dr < h:
                if 0 <= c-2 < w: out[r+dr][c-2] = 2
                if 0 <= c+2 < w: out[r+dr][c+2] = 2
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
PY
